CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Registration_Expiry__c), ISBLANK(Insurance_Expiry__c)), "Missing", IF(OR(Registration_Expiry__c < TODAY(), Insurance_Expiry__c < TODAY(), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Fitness_Expiry__c)), Fitness_Expiry__c < TODAY())), "Expired", IF(OR(Registration_Expiry__c <= TODAY() + $CustomMetadata.eLogix_Setting__mdt.Document_Expiry_Warning_Days.Number_Value__c, Insurance_Expiry__c <= TODAY() + $CustomMetadata.eLogix_Setting__mdt.Document_Expiry_Warning_Days.Number_Value__c, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Fitness_Expiry__c)), Fitness_Expiry__c <= TODAY() + $CustomMetadata.eLogix_Setting__mdt.Document_Expiry_Warning_Days.Number_Value__c)), "Expiring Soon", "Valid")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Missing, Expired, Expiring Soon (within the eLogix setting Document_Expiry_Warning_Days) or Valid, across registration, insurance and fitness.
CustomField.label: Document Status
